source_note: Transcribed from full-resolution card images sent 2026-11-05. Numbers read off the card face: cost top-left, life on the heart, strength bottom-right. SW Zone's setup sheet marks events as 2 copies and lists the starting units.

cards.name: Taculla
cards.ability: When this unit attacks an enemy unit and the damage would destroy it, you may instead ignore that damage and take control of the target.

cards.name: Mind Control
cards.ability: Target any number of enemy commons and champions within 2 spaces of your summoner. Take control of the targets until the end of your turn.

cards.name: Gwalark
cards.ability: Flight: when this unit moves it may move 1 extra space and through cards. Levitate: any friendly common that starts its move within 2 spaces of this unit has Flight during that move.

cards.name: Gulldune
cards.ability: After this unit attacks an enemy card, it may target a friendly common within 3 spaces; that target resolves an extra attack.

cards.name: Halal
cards.ability: Greater Push: after this unit attacks, or instead of attacking, it may target a common or champion within 3 spaces and force the target 1 space. Steadfast: this unit cannot be forced.

cards.name: Wind Archer
cards.ability: Swift: when this unit moves it may move 1 extra space. Far Shot: it may attack cards up to 4 clear straight spaces away.

cards.name: Wind Mage
cards.ability: After this unit attacks, or instead of attacking, it may target a common or champion within 2 spaces and force the target 1 space.

cards.name: Mind Witch
cards.ability: At the start of your Move Phase this unit may target a common within 3 spaces; it has the target's abilities until the end of your turn.

cards.name: Deceiver
cards.ability: Stupefy: when an adjacent enemy attacks any card and rolls 1 or more hits, the attack adds 1 less damage. Engage: each time an adjacent enemy unit moves or is forced away from this unit, add 1 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Hypnotic Call
cards.ability: Target a common or champion; you may force the target 1 space toward your summoner. ACTIVE: your summoner has +1 strength when attacking the target.

cards.name: Blast
cards.ability: Target a common or champion within 3 clear straight spaces of your summoner. Force it 1 to 3 spaces, possibly through commons and champions. Add 1 damage to the target and to each unit it was forced through.
